title_sq: GARZONIERE PER SHITJE TEK KOMUNA PARISIT
description_sq:
Shitet garzoniere tek komuna parisit.
Ndodhet ne katin e 7 me 2 ashensora.
E pershtatshme per investim pasi mer nje qera prej 500 euro ne muaj.
Siperfaqje prej 25 m2.
E sapo investuar e pabanuar me pare.
Me dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: APARTMENTS FOR SALE IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF PARIS
description_en: Studio for sale in Paris municipality. It is located on the 7th floor with 2 elevators. Suitable for investment as it receives a rent of 500 euros per month. Surface of 25 m2. Newly invested, never lived in before. With regular mortgage documentation.
